loss_analysis: Compute harm, missed-repair opportunities and action residuals separately per dataset; never average NQ EM with FEVER label accuracy
single_candidate: Choose one target dataset/action/rule bottleneck on development; one concentrated candidate only

selection.targeted_change: Target dataset positive paired net correct gain; other dataset must not regress
selection.cross_dataset_change: Nonnegative paired net correct gain on both datasets and positive gain on at least one
selection.ties: Keep frozen baseline when no positive gain
selection.semantic_review: Unresolved human judgments remain separate bounds, never relabeled to pass selection

gate_limits: This supplement changes no model, module prompt, diagnosis parameter, threshold, dataset role or T4 action; it clarifies the later one-candidate selection rule
